prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='FT_catboost', seasonality_champion='DWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: FT_catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) with the lowest RMSE (33.298), making it the trend and overall champion. DWT_catboost dominates seasonality capture with 0.7195 correlation, significantly higher than competitors. High model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=31.16) and seasonality variance indicate STL-hierarchical stacking is optimal to combine complementary trend/seasonal strengths. RF excels at both early (18.60) and late (26.53) horizons, showing robust short-term performance.
